systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: INTERPOL programme, funded by the European Union with the ECOWAS Commission
systems.tiers: nothing on Ghana's own sites; Ghana is named for a 2022 awareness event of more than 300 participants; across the region the system sits in a national data collection and registration centre in the capital, with extension to remote sites and border posts planned for 2023

systems.owner: not stated; the WAPIS AFIS project is run by INTERPOL and CIVIPOL with European Union funds
systems.tiers: Ghana holds an existing AFIS, which the project's steering committee of 21 July 2022 recommended strengthening in a second phase, with Niger, Nigeria and Senegal
Ghana is one of five countries whose SIPAO users can query INTERPOL's global databases from their workstations, as at December 2022

note: No fact: for Ghana the newsletter gives an awareness event, an existing fingerprint system to be strengthened and the link from SIPAO to I-24/7; it describes SIPAO as central data centres collecting police data and never says that stations in Ghana enter their cases in it, so the class is left empty.
